      "title": "Three-involution bound for the first length parameter in dihedral groups",
      "source_url": "https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.02844",
      "literal": "Let $D_n$ be a dihedral group with an order $n$ cyclic subgroup, and let $S$ be a generating set composed of three involutions, none of which belongs to that cyclic subgroup.
